findings.expected: The orbital emblem and supporting Northline signal note should resolve as a complete, readable mobile composition.
findings.observed: The emblem continues beyond the bottom edge of the supplied mobile render; the supporting note is not readable and only a lower horizontal rule is visible.

findings.expected: The secondary triage reassurance should have deliberate alignment and spacing relative to the full-width primary CTA.
findings.observed: “IMMEDIATE PHONE TRIAGE / AVAILABLE NOW” is left-aligned at the shell gutter beneath the CTA, reading as an orphaned label rather than a deliberately grouped support message.

findings.expected: The layout transition between the two-column desktop state and the stacked mobile state should be checked at an intermediate width.
findings.observed: Only 1440x900 and 390x844 native renders are supplied. The artifact changes layout at max-width:900px, but no intermediate render is available.

findings.location: Keyboard, focus, contrast, and interaction states
findings.expected: Focus visibility, keyboard operation, telephone-link behavior, and actual contrast should be verified on the rendered artifact.
findings.observed: The HTML includes semantic landmarks, a labeled heading, accessible SVG titles/descriptions, and a focus-visible rule, but no focus, keyboard, interaction, or contrast evidence is supplied.
findings.evidence: artifact_v2/index.html:2, 42, 87-110; default-only desktop and mobile renders

top_corrections.correction: Recompose the mobile lower hero so the orbital mark and Northline signal note are either fully readable in the tested viewport or intentionally treated as below-fold content.
top_corrections.impact: Improves mobile composition closure and resolves the tension with the “Always visible” supporting copy.

top_corrections.correction: Make the mobile triage reassurance a block-level element with explicit alignment and spacing beneath the CTA.
top_corrections.impact: Improves CTA grouping, scan rhythm, and responsive stability.

top_corrections.correction: Inspect an intermediate render around 768px and verify focus-visible, keyboard, tap, and contrast behavior before final acceptance.
top_corrections.impact: Closes the remaining responsive and accessibility evidence gaps.
